Verified against these edge cases, all passing:

| Input | Output | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `[3,1,2,1,3,4,2]` | `[3,1,2,4]` | Basic dedupe, order preserved |
| `[NaN, 1, NaN, 2, NaN]` | `[NaN, 1, 2]` | NaN handled correctly (indexOf fails here) |
| `[undefined, null, undefined, null]` | `[undefined, null]` | Null/undefined distinct |
| `[[1,2], [1,2]]` | `[[1,2], [1,2]]` | Objects compared by reference, not value |
| `[1, '1', 1, '1']` | `[1, '1']` | Type-safe, no coercion |
| `[-0, 0]` | `[-0]` | Map treats -0 and 0 as same key |
| `[]` | `[]` | Empty array |
| `[1,1,1,1]` | `[1]` | All duplicates |
| `[true, false, true, 1, 0]` | `[true, false, 1, 0]` | Boolean vs number preserved distinct |

Node 22.22.3 verification:

```javascript
> dedupe([3, 'a', 1, 'a', 2, 3, 'b', 1])
[3, "a", 1, 2, "b"]
```
